title: Ninja Legacy
author: NinjaLegacyDev
selftext:
Hello!

I’ve been using Claude Ai to develop my first game ever. It’s still in early stages of development but I wanted to go ahead and invite others to the official Discord server where I’ll be posting updates, gameplay, taking suggestions, etc.

The Game:

It’s called “Ninja Legacy” because it initially started as a re-creation of the old mobile game “Ninja Royale” and turned into me making my own thing.

It has various features that work well from other games but I tweaked them to make them my own. Whether you liked the original Ninja Royale, RuneScape, DOFUS, Wakfu, Knights & Dragons, or similar games, I think there’s something in this for everyone to enjoy.

Join the official Discord server below and in the morning I’ll have some screenshots and gameplay in its current state available!

https://discord.gg/CCKbbvQ4n
